source.text: וְאַחַ֗ר בָּ֚אוּ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֑ה כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י וְיָחֹ֥גּוּ לִ֖י בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And afterward came Moses and Aaron and said to Pharaoh, thus says Yahweh, [the] God of Israel, let go my people, that they may hold a festival to me in the wilderness.

en.L: And afterward Moses and Aaron came and said to Pharaoh, "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel: 'Let {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people go, that they may hold a festival to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in the wilderness.'"
en.B: After that, Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh and told him, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says, 'Release {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people so that they can celebrate a festival for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in the wilderness.'"
en.R: After that, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh. They said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says this: 'Let {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people go. They must go into the desert to hold a feast to honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'"

es.L: Y después fueron Moisés y Aarón y dijeron al faraón: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel: “Deja ir a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, para que celebren fiesta para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en el desierto”».
es.B: Después de esto, Moisés y Aarón se presentaron ante el faraón y le dijeron: «Esto dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel: “Deja salir a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo para que celebre en el desierto una fiesta en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} honor”».
es.R: Después, Moisés y Aarón fueron a ver al faraón. Le dijeron: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, dice: “Deja ir a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. Tienen que ir al desierto para hacer una fiesta en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} honor”».

fr.L: Et après, Moïse et Aaron vinrent et dirent à Pharaon : « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : “Laisse partir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, pour qu’ils célèbrent pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} une fête dans le désert.” »
fr.B: Après cela, Moïse et Aaron se rendirent chez Pharaon et lui dirent : « Voici ce que déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : “Laisse aller {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, afin qu’il célèbre en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} honneur une fête au désert.” »
fr.R: Ensuite, Moïse et Aaron sont allés voir Pharaon. Ils lui ont dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : “Laisse partir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. Ils doivent aller dans le désert pour faire une fête en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} honneur.” »

sw.L: Na baadaye Musa na Haruni wakaenda, wakamwambia Farao, "Hivi ndivyo asemavyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli: 'Waache watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} waende, ili wanifanyie sikukuu jangwani.'"
sw.B: Baada ya hayo, Musa na Haruni waliingia kwa Farao, wakamwambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi: 'Waachilie watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} waende nyikani wakanifanyie sikukuu.'"
sw.R: Baada ya hayo, Musa na Haruni walikwenda kwa Farao. Wakamwambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, anasema hivi: 'Waache watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} waende. Ni lazima waende jangwani kufanya sikukuu ya kuniheshimu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}.'"

decisions.choice: hold a festival: celebrate a pilgrimage feast
decisions.reason: The verb is used of the pilgrim feasts at which Israel gathered before God (23:14). In 3:18 the request was to sacrifice; a feast included sacrifice and a shared meal.

decisions.choice: let my people go: the demand repeated through the plagues
decisions.reason: The words are said again and again to Pharaoh (7:16, 26; 9:1). "My people" sets God's claim against Pharaoh's.

decisions.choice: thus says Yahweh: the messenger formula
decisions.reason: A messenger repeated his master's words in the first person. The prophets use the same formula. Moses and Aaron speak as God's messengers.

decisions.choice: passé simple for the narrative at Literal and Balanced ("vinrent", "dirent", "se rendirent"); passé composé at Readable ("sont allés", "ont dit"); speech in the tenses of speech at every level
decisions.reason: As the French style guide: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, the passé composé the tense French readers use and hear today.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה מִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶשְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹל֔וֹ לְשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹ֤א יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה וְגַ֥ם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א אֲשַׁלֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Pharaoh, who [is] Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let go Israel? I do not know Yahweh, and also Israel I will not let go.

en.L: And Pharaoh said, "Who [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that I should listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice to let Israel go? I do not know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and moreover, I will not let Israel go."
en.B: Pharaoh replied, "Who is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that I should do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says and release Israel? I do not know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I will certainly not let Israel go."
en.R: But Pharaoh said, "Who is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? Why should I obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and let the Israelites go? I do not know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I will not let Israel go!"

es.L: Y dijo el faraón: «¿Quién [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} para que yo escuche {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz y deje ir a Israel? No conozco {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y además no dejaré ir a Israel».
es.B: El faraón respondió: «¿Quién es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} para que yo haga lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice y deje salir a Israel? No conozco {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y de ninguna manera dejaré ir a Israel».
es.R: Pero el faraón dijo: «¿Quién es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}? ¿Por qué {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} voy a obedecer y a dejar ir a los israelitas? Yo no conozco {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, ¡y no dejaré ir a Israel!».

fr.L: Et Pharaon dit : « Qui [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour que j’écoute {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix et que je laisse partir Israël ? Je ne connais pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et de plus je ne laisserai pas partir Israël. »
fr.B: Pharaon répondit : « Qui est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour que je fasse ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit en laissant aller Israël ? Je ne connais pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je ne laisserai certainement pas partir Israël. »
fr.R: Mais Pharaon a dit : « Qui est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Pourquoi devrais-je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéir et laisser partir les Israélites ? Je ne connais pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je ne laisserai pas partir Israël ! »

sw.L: Naye Farao akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] nani, hata niisikilize sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kumwacha Israeli aende? Simjui {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tena sitamwacha Israeli aende."
sw.B: Farao akajibu, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni nani, hata nifanye anavyosema na kumwachilia Israeli? Simjui {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na hakika sitamwacha Israeli aende."
sw.R: Lakini Farao akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni nani? Kwa nini nimtii na kuwaacha Waisraeli waende? Simjui {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na sitawaacha Waisraeli waende!"

decisions.choice: I do not know Yahweh: I do not recognise him or his authority
decisions.reason: To "know" a god is to acknowledge him. The plagues answer Pharaoh's words: God acts so that Pharaoh and Egypt "will know that I am Yahweh" (7:5, 17; 14:4).

decisions.choice: listen to his voice: obey him
decisions.reason: "Listen to the voice of" means to obey.

decisions.choice: the Israelites
decisions.reason: Readable says that the people, not one man, are meant by "Israel" the first time.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָעִבְרִ֖ים נִקְרָ֣א עָלֵ֑ינוּ נֵ֣לֲכָה נָּ֡א דֶּרֶךְ֩ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת יָמִ֜ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר וְנִזְבְּחָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ פֶּ֨ן־יִפְגָּעֵ֔נוּ בַּדֶּ֖בֶר א֥וֹ בֶחָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said, [the] God of the Hebrews has met with us; let us go, please, [a] journey of three days into the wilderness and sacrifice to Yahweh our God, lest he fall upon us with plague or with sword.

en.L: And they said, "The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go a journey of three days into the wilderness and sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, lest {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fall upon us with plague or with sword."
en.B: They said, "The God of the Hebrews has come to meet us. Please let us travel three days into the wilderness to offer sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, or {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may strike us down with disease or war."
en.R: Moses and Aaron said, "The God of the Hebrews has come to us. Please let us go three days' journey into the desert to offer sacrifices to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, our God. If we do not, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might send sickness on us or let us be killed in war."

es.L: Y dijeron: «El Dios de los hebreos nos ha salido al encuentro. Déjanos ir, te rogamos, camino de tres días por el desierto, y ofrezcamos sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, no sea que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} caiga sobre nosotros con peste o con espada».
es.B: Ellos dijeron: «El Dios de los hebreos ha venido a nuestro encuentro. Te rogamos que nos dejes hacer un viaje de tres días por el desierto para ofrecer sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios; si no, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} podría castigarnos con enfermedades o con guerra».
es.R: Moisés y Aarón le dijeron: «El Dios de los hebreos ha venido a nosotros. Por favor, déjanos caminar tres días por el desierto para ofrecer sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, nuestro Dios. Si no lo hacemos, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} podría mandarnos enfermedades, o podríamos morir en la guerra».

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Le Dieu des Hébreux est venu à notre rencontre. Laisse-nous aller, je te prie, à trois jours de marche dans le désert, et sacrifier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} notre Dieu, de peur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne nous frappe par la peste ou par l’épée. »
fr.B: Ils dirent : « Le Dieu des Hébreux s’est présenté à nous. Permets-nous, s’il te plaît, de faire trois jours de route dans le désert pour offrir des sacrifices {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} notre Dieu ; sinon, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pourrait nous frapper par la maladie ou par la guerre. »
fr.R: Moïse et Aaron ont dit : « Le Dieu des Hébreux est venu vers nous. S’il te plaît, laisse-nous marcher pendant trois jours dans le désert pour offrir des sacrifices {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, notre Dieu. Si nous ne le faisons pas, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pourrait nous envoyer des maladies, ou nous faire mourir à la guerre. »

sw.L: Nao wakasema, "Mungu wa Waebrania amekutana nasi. Tafadhali, tuache twende safari ya siku tatu jangwani, tumtolee dhabihu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, asije akatuangukia kwa tauni au kwa upanga."
sw.B: Wakasema, "Mungu wa Waebrania amekuja kukutana nasi. Tafadhali turuhusu tusafiri mwendo wa siku tatu nyikani, tumtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu dhabihu, la sivyo atatupiga kwa magonjwa au kwa vita."
sw.R: Musa na Haruni wakasema, "Mungu wa Waebrania amekuja kwetu. Tafadhali tuache twende safari ya siku tatu jangwani, tukamtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wetu, dhabihu. Tusipofanya hivyo, anaweza kutuletea magonjwa au kuacha tuuawe vitani."

decisions.choice: plague or sword: deadly disease or death in war
decisions.reason: The two words are often paired for disaster (Leviticus 26:25; Jeremiah 14:12). The first word is the one for the plague on livestock in 9:3.

decisions.choice: has met with us ... three days: the words God gave in 3:18
decisions.reason: Moses and Aaron say what they were told to say. They add a reason Pharaoh may understand: a god who is not obeyed may strike.

decisions.choice: Moses and Aaron
decisions.reason: Readable names the speakers.

decisions.choice: no span for "he": "asije akatuangukia", "atatupiga"
decisions.reason: The pronoun for God is the subject prefix of the verb, where no capital is possible, so Swahili has no deity pronoun span where the English "he" has one.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָ֚מָּה מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן תַּפְרִ֥יעוּ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם מִמַּֽעֲשָׂ֑יו לְכ֖וּ לְסִבְלֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to them [the] king of Egypt, why, Moses and Aaron, do you draw away the people from its work? Go to your burdens.

en.L: And the king of Egypt said to them, "Moses and Aaron, why do you draw the people away from their work? Go to your burdens!"
en.B: The king of Egypt answered them, "Moses and Aaron, why are you distracting the people from their tasks? Get back to your labor!"
en.R: The king of Egypt said, "Moses and Aaron, why are you keeping the people from doing their work? Go back to work, all of you!"

es.L: Y les dijo el rey de Egipto: «¿Por qué, Moisés y Aarón, {{plural_you:apartan|apartáis}} al pueblo de sus trabajos? ¡{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} cargas!».
es.B: El rey de Egipto les respondió: «Moisés y Aarón, ¿por qué {{plural_you:distraen|distraéis}} al pueblo de sus tareas? ¡{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} trabajos forzados!».
es.R: El rey de Egipto les dijo: «Moisés y Aarón, ¿por qué no {{plural_you:dejan|dejáis}} que el pueblo haga su trabajo? ¡{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} todos a trabajar!».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Égypte leur dit : « Pourquoi, Moïse et Aaron, détournez-vous le peuple de ses travaux ? Allez à vos corvées ! »
fr.B: Le roi d’Égypte leur répondit : « Moïse et Aaron, pourquoi détournez-vous le peuple de son ouvrage ? Retournez à vos travaux forcés ! »
fr.R: Le roi d’Égypte a dit : « Moïse et Aaron, pourquoi empêchez-vous le peuple de faire son travail ? Retournez au travail, vous tous ! »

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Misri akawaambia, "Musa na Haruni, mbona mnawazuia watu na kazi zao? Nendeni kwenye mizigo yenu!"
sw.B: Mfalme wa Misri akawajibu, "Musa na Haruni, kwa nini mnawavuruga watu wasifanye kazi zao? Rudini kwenye kazi zenu za kulazimishwa!"
sw.R: Mfalme wa Misri akasema, "Musa na Haruni, kwa nini mnawazuia watu wasifanye kazi yao? Rudini kazini, ninyi nyote!"

decisions.choice: draw away: let loose, keep from working
decisions.reason: The verb means to let go or neglect. The king accuses Moses and Aaron of making the people idle.

decisions.choice: your burdens: your forced labor
decisions.reason: The word is the one in 1:11 and 2:11. "Your" is plural and may include Moses and Aaron, as Hebrews, with the people.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה הֵן־רַבִּ֥ים עַתָּ֖ה עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁבַּתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם מִסִּבְלֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Pharaoh, look, many now [are the] people of the land, and you make them cease from their burdens.

en.L: And Pharaoh said, "Look, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens!"
en.B: Pharaoh went on, "Look how numerous these people of the land have become, and you want to give them rest from their labor!"
en.R: Pharaoh said, "There are so many of these people now, and you want to stop them from working!"

es.L: Y dijo el faraón: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, el pueblo de la tierra es ahora numeroso, ¡y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} descansar de sus cargas!».
es.B: Y añadió el faraón: «¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} cuánto ha crecido ahora la gente de este país, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} darles descanso de sus trabajos!».
es.R: El faraón dijo: «¡Ahora hay muchísima gente de ese pueblo, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} que dejen de trabajar!».

fr.L: Et Pharaon dit : « Voici, le peuple du pays est maintenant nombreux, et vous les faites chômer de leurs corvées ! »
fr.B: Pharaon reprit : « Voyez comme ces gens du pays sont devenus nombreux, et vous voudriez leur faire interrompre leurs travaux ! »
fr.R: Pharaon a dit : « Ces gens sont très nombreux maintenant, et vous voulez qu’ils arrêtent de travailler ! »

sw.L: Naye Farao akasema, "Tazama, watu wa nchi sasa ni wengi, nanyi mnawapumzisha na mizigo yao!"
sw.B: Farao akaendelea, "Tazameni jinsi watu hawa wa nchi walivyokuwa wengi sasa, nanyi mnataka kuwapumzisha na kazi zao!"
sw.R: Farao akasema, "Watu hawa ni wengi sana sasa, nanyi mnataka waache kufanya kazi!"

decisions.choice: the people of the land: here the Hebrew workers, so many in number
decisions.reason: The phrase usually means the common people of a land. Here it seems to mean the Hebrews, whose numbers the king fears (1:9). The Samaritan Pentateuch reads "they are more than the people of the land".

decisions.choice: make them cease: give them rest
decisions.reason: The verb is the root of "Sabbath". Pharaoh will not allow the people a day of rest.

source.text: וַיְצַ֥ו פַּרְעֹ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֶת־הַנֹּגְשִׂ֣ים בָּעָ֔ם וְאֶת־שֹׁטְרָ֖יו לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And commanded Pharaoh on that day the taskmasters over the people and its foremen, saying,

en.L: And Pharaoh commanded on that day the taskmasters over the people and their foremen, saying,
en.B: That same day Pharaoh gave orders to the taskmasters over the people and to their foremen:
en.R: That same day Pharaoh gave orders to the Egyptian bosses and to the Israelite crew leaders who were in charge of the people.

es.L: Y mandó el faraón aquel día a los capataces del pueblo y a sus encargados, diciendo:
es.B: Ese mismo día el faraón dio órdenes a los capataces del pueblo y a sus encargados:
es.R: Ese mismo día el faraón dio órdenes a los capataces egipcios y a los jefes de cuadrilla israelitas que estaban a cargo del pueblo.

fr.L: Et Pharaon commanda ce jour-là aux chefs de corvée du peuple et à ses contremaîtres, en disant :
fr.B: Le jour même, Pharaon donna ses ordres aux chefs de corvée du peuple et à ses contremaîtres :
fr.R: Le jour même, Pharaon a donné des ordres aux chefs égyptiens et aux chefs d’équipe israélites qui dirigeaient le peuple.

sw.L: Naye Farao akawaamuru siku ile wanyapara wa watu na wasimamizi wao, akisema,
sw.B: Siku hiyo hiyo Farao aliwaamuru wanyapara wa watu na wasimamizi wao,
sw.R: Siku hiyo hiyo Farao aliwapa amri wanyapara wa Kimisri na viongozi wa vikundi wa Kiisraeli waliowasimamia watu.

decisions.choice: taskmasters ... foremen: Egyptian overseers and Israelite officers
decisions.reason: The taskmasters are Egyptians (3:7). The foremen are Israelites placed over their own people (verse 14), who keep the records and answer for the work. The second word is used later for officials in Israel (Numbers 11:16; Deuteronomy 16:18).

decisions.choice: Egyptian bosses ... Israelite crew leaders
decisions.reason: Readable says who each group was, as verse 14 shows. It ends the sentence here; Pharaoh's words follow in verse 7.

decisions.choice: "capataces" (taskmasters) and "encargados" (foremen)
decisions.reason: The two groups are Egyptian overseers and Israelite officers (meaning decision). "Capataces" are the men who drive the labor; "encargados" are those responsible for each crew and its count of bricks. Readable names them "capataces egipcios" and "jefes de cuadrilla israelitas", as the English Readable explains.

decisions.choice: "chefs de corvée" (taskmasters) and "contremaîtres" (foremen)
decisions.reason: Two different groups: Egyptian overseers who drive the forced labor, and Israelite officers who answer for their crews (meaning decision). "Chefs de corvée" ties the first to the corvée of 1:11; "contremaîtres" says plainly that the second lead the work gangs. Used for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: "wanyapara" (taskmasters) and "wasimamizi" (foremen)
decisions.reason: "Mnyapara" is the overseer who drives a labor gang; "msimamizi" is the supervisor answerable for a crew, here the Israelite officers (meaning decision). Readable says "wanyapara wa Kimisri" and "viongozi wa vikundi wa Kiisraeli", as the English Readable explains.

source.text: לֹ֣א תֹאסִפ֞וּן לָתֵ֨ת תֶּ֧בֶן לָעָ֛ם לִלְבֹּ֥ן הַלְּבֵנִ֖ים כִּתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֑ם הֵ֚ם יֵֽלְכ֔וּ וְקֹשְׁשׁ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם תֶּֽבֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: You shall not continue to give straw to the people to make the bricks as yesterday [and the day] before; they, let them go and gather for themselves straw.

en.L: "You shall no longer give the people straw to make the bricks, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.
en.B: "Do not supply the people with straw for brickmaking any longer, as you have been doing. Let them go out and collect their own straw.
en.R: He said, "Do not give the people any more straw for making bricks. Let them go and find their own straw.

es.L: «No {{plural_you:volverán|volveréis}} a dar paja al pueblo para hacer los ladrillos, como ayer y anteayer. Que vayan ellos y recojan paja para sí.
es.B: «No {{plural_you:sigan|sigáis}} dándole al pueblo paja para fabricar ladrillos, como lo {{plural_you:han|habéis}} hecho hasta ahora. Que salgan ellos mismos a recoger su paja.
es.R: Les dijo: «Ya no les {{plural_you:den|deis}} paja a esos hombres para hacer ladrillos. Que vayan ellos a buscar su propia paja.

fr.L: « Vous ne continuerez plus à donner de la paille au peuple pour faire les briques, comme hier [et] avant-hier. Qu’ils aillent eux-mêmes ramasser de la paille pour eux.
fr.B: « Ne fournissez plus au peuple la paille pour fabriquer les briques, comme vous le faisiez jusqu’ici. Qu’ils aillent eux-mêmes ramasser leur paille.
fr.R: Il a dit : « Ne donnez plus de paille à ces gens pour faire les briques. Qu’ils aillent chercher leur paille eux-mêmes.

sw.L: "Msiendelee tena kuwapa watu majani ya kufanyia matofali kama jana na juzi. Wao waende wakajikusanyie majani wenyewe.
sw.B: "Msiwape watu tena majani ya kutengenezea matofali kama mlivyokuwa mkifanya. Waende wenyewe wakakusanye majani yao.
sw.R: Alisema, "Msiwape watu hawa majani tena ya kufanyia matofali. Waende wakatafute majani yao wenyewe.

decisions.choice: straw: chopped straw mixed into mud bricks
decisions.reason: Chopped straw was mixed into the clay to bind it and make the bricks stronger. Without straw provided, the workers must find it themselves and still make as many bricks.

decisions.choice: as yesterday and the day before: as before
decisions.reason: The phrase means "as in the past" (4:10).

decisions.choice: "comme hier [et] avant-hier"
decisions.reason: French has the same pair of words for "yesterday, three days ago" (meaning decision: "as before"), so Literal keeps the idiom, with the "and" French needs in brackets. Balanced and Readable say what it means.

source.text: וְאֶת־מַתְכֹּ֨נֶת הַלְּבֵנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵם֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים תְּמ֤וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם֙ תָּשִׂ֣ימוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־נִרְפִּ֣ים הֵ֔ם עַל־כֵּ֗ן הֵ֤ם צֹֽעֲקִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר נֵלְכָ֖ה נִזְבְּחָ֥ה לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the quota of the bricks which they were making yesterday [and the day] before you shall put upon them; you shall not reduce from it, for idle they [are]; therefore they cry out, saying, let us go, let us sacrifice to our God.

en.L: But you shall lay on them the quota of bricks that they were making before; you shall not reduce it. For they are idle; that is why they cry out, saying, 'Let us go and sacrifice to our God.'
en.B: But require of them the same number of bricks as before; do not lower the quota. They are idle, which is why they keep calling out, 'Let us go and sacrifice to our God.'
en.R: But make them produce as many bricks as they did before. Do not let them make fewer. They are lazy! That is why they keep shouting, 'Let us go and offer sacrifices to our God.'

es.L: Pero la cantidad de ladrillos que hacían ayer y anteayer se la {{plural_you:impondrán|impondréis}}; no la {{plural_you:reducirán|reduciréis}}, porque están ociosos; por eso gritan diciendo: “Vayamos a ofrecer sacrificios a nuestro Dios”.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:exíjanles|exigidles}} la misma cantidad de ladrillos que antes; no {{plural_you:rebajen|rebajéis}} la cuota. Son unos holgazanes, y por eso andan clamando: “Vayamos a ofrecer sacrificios a nuestro Dios”.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:oblíguenlos|obligadlos}} a hacer tantos ladrillos como antes. No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que hagan menos. ¡Son unos perezosos! Por eso no paran de gritar: “Queremos ir a ofrecer sacrificios a nuestro Dios”.

fr.L: Et la quantité de briques qu’ils faisaient hier [et] avant-hier, vous la leur imposerez ; vous n’en retrancherez rien, car ils sont paresseux ; c’est pourquoi ils crient en disant : “Allons sacrifier à notre Dieu !”
fr.B: Mais exigez d’eux le même nombre de briques qu’auparavant ; ne diminuez pas la quantité. Ce sont des paresseux, et c’est pour cela qu’ils réclament : “Allons offrir des sacrifices à notre Dieu !”
fr.R: Mais obligez-les à faire autant de briques qu’avant. Ne les laissez pas en faire moins. Ce sont des paresseux ! C’est pour ça qu’ils n’arrêtent pas de crier : “Nous voulons aller offrir des sacrifices à notre Dieu !”

sw.L: Na hesabu ya matofali waliyokuwa wakifanya jana na juzi mtawatwika; msiipunguze, kwa maana ni wavivu; kwa hiyo wanalia wakisema, 'Twende tukamtolee Mungu wetu dhabihu.'
sw.B: Lakini wadaini idadi ile ile ya matofali kama zamani; msiipunguze. Ni wavivu, ndiyo sababu wanapiga kelele, wakisema, 'Twende tukamtolee Mungu wetu dhabihu.'
sw.R: Lakini walazimisheni kufanya matofali mengi kama zamani. Msiwaache wafanye machache. Ni wavivu! Ndiyo maana wanaendelea kupiga kelele, 'Tunataka kwenda kumtolea Mungu wetu dhabihu.'

decisions.choice: idle: slack, lazy
decisions.reason: The verb means to sink or slacken. Pharaoh calls the people's request for worship laziness; it is the same word in verse 17.

decisions.choice: cry out: shout, demand
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for Israel's cry to God in 3:7, 9. Pharaoh hears it as noisy complaint.

source.text: תִּכְבַּ֧ד הָעֲבֹדָ֛ה עַל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וְיַעֲשׂוּ־בָ֑הּ וְאַל־יִשְׁע֖וּ בְּדִבְרֵי־שָֽׁקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: Let the labor be heavy on the men, and let them work at it and not pay attention to words of falsehood.

en.L: Let the labor be heavy upon the men, and let them work at it, and let them not pay attention to lying words."
en.B: Make the work heavier for these men; keep them busy at it so that they will not listen to lies."
en.R: Make the work harder for them. Keep them so busy that they will not listen to lies."

es.L: Hágase pesado el trabajo sobre los hombres, y que se ocupen en él, y no presten atención a palabras de mentira».
es.B: {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} más pesado el trabajo de esos hombres; que estén ocupados en él y no hagan caso de mentiras».
es.R: {{plural_you:Háganles|Hacedles}} el trabajo más duro. Que estén tan ocupados que no escuchen mentiras».

fr.L: Que le travail pèse sur ces hommes, et qu’ils s’y occupent, et qu’ils ne prêtent pas attention à des paroles de mensonge. »
fr.B: Alourdissez la tâche de ces hommes ; qu’ils soient occupés à leur travail, et qu’ils n’écoutent plus les mensonges. »
fr.R: Rendez leur travail plus dur. Ils doivent être si occupés qu’ils n’écouteront plus les mensonges. »

sw.L: Kazi na iwe nzito juu ya watu hao, wapate kuishughulikia, wala wasiyasikilize maneno ya uongo."
sw.B: Wazidishieni watu hao kazi; washughulike nayo ili wasisikilize maneno ya uongo."
sw.R: Wafanyeni wafanye kazi ngumu zaidi. Wawe na shughuli nyingi mpaka wasisikilize uongo."

decisions.choice: let it be heavy: make the work harder
decisions.reason: The verb is from the root "heavy", used later of Pharaoh's heart being "heavy" (hardened, 8:11). Pharaoh makes the labor heavy; his heart becomes heavy.

decisions.choice: words of falsehood: lies
decisions.reason: Pharaoh calls the message of Moses and Aaron lies.

source.text: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ נֹגְשֵׂ֤י הָעָם֙ וְשֹׁ֣טְרָ֔יו וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֶל־הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֵינֶ֛נִּי נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם תֶּֽבֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out [the] taskmasters of the people and its foremen and said to the people, saying, thus says Pharaoh, I am not giving you straw.

en.L: And the taskmasters of the people and their foremen went out and spoke to the people, saying, "Thus says Pharaoh: 'I am not giving you straw.
en.B: So the taskmasters and foremen went out and announced to the people, "Pharaoh says, 'I will give you no more straw.
en.R: So the Egyptian bosses and the Israelite crew leaders went out and told the people, "Pharaoh says, 'I will not give you any more straw.

es.L: Y salieron los capataces del pueblo y sus encargados y hablaron al pueblo, diciendo: «Así dice el faraón: “No {{plural_you:les|os}} doy paja.
es.B: Entonces los capataces y los encargados salieron y anunciaron al pueblo: «El faraón dice: “Ya no {{plural_you:les|os}} daré paja.
es.R: Entonces los capataces egipcios y los jefes de cuadrilla israelitas fueron y le dijeron al pueblo: «El faraón dice: “No {{plural_you:les|os}} voy a dar más paja.

fr.L: Et les chefs de corvée du peuple et ses contremaîtres sortirent et parlèrent au peuple, en disant : « Ainsi parle Pharaon : “Je ne vous donne pas de paille.
fr.B: Les chefs de corvée et les contremaîtres sortirent donc et déclarèrent au peuple : « Pharaon dit : “Je ne vous donnerai plus de paille.
fr.R: Alors les chefs égyptiens et les chefs d’équipe israélites sont sortis et ont dit au peuple : « Pharaon dit : “Je ne vous donnerai plus de paille.

sw.L: Nao wanyapara wa watu na wasimamizi wao wakatoka, wakawaambia watu, wakisema, "Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Farao: 'Siwapi majani.
sw.B: Basi wanyapara na wasimamizi walitoka, wakawatangazia watu, "Farao asema hivi: 'Sitawapa majani tena.
sw.R: Basi wanyapara wa Kimisri na viongozi wa vikundi wa Kiisraeli walikwenda, wakawaambia watu, "Farao anasema: 'Sitawapa majani tena.

decisions.choice: thus says Pharaoh: the same formula as "thus says Yahweh" (verse 1)
decisions.reason: Two masters give orders in the same words. The question of the book is whose word Israel will obey.

source.text: אַתֶּ֗ם לְכ֨וּ קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ תֶּ֔בֶן מֵאֲשֶׁ֖ר תִּמְצָ֑אוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין נִגְרָ֛ע מֵעֲבֹדַתְכֶ֖ם דָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: You, go, get for yourselves straw from wherever you can find [it], for nothing will be reduced from your labor.

en.L: Go yourselves, get straw for yourselves wherever you can find [it]; for nothing will be reduced from your labor.'"
en.B: Go and get straw for yourselves wherever you can find it. But your workload will not be reduced one bit.'"
en.R: Go and find straw for yourselves wherever you can. But you must still make just as many bricks as before.'"

es.L: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}}, {{plural_you:vayan|id}}, {{plural_you:consíganse|conseguíos}} paja donde la {{plural_you:encuentren|encontréis}}, porque no se {{plural_you:les|os}} rebajará nada de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} trabajo”».
es.B: {{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos a buscar paja donde la {{plural_you:encuentren|encontréis}}. Pero {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} trabajo no se reducirá en lo más mínimo”».
es.R: {{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} paja donde {{plural_you:puedan|podáis}}. Pero {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} que hacer los mismos ladrillos que antes”».

fr.L: Vous, allez, procurez-vous de la paille là où vous [en] trouverez, car rien ne sera retranché de votre travail.” »
fr.B: Allez vous-mêmes chercher de la paille où vous pourrez en trouver. Mais votre tâche ne sera pas diminuée le moins du monde.” »
fr.R: Allez chercher de la paille où vous pourrez. Mais vous devrez quand même faire autant de briques qu’avant.” »

sw.L: Ninyi, nendeni, mjipatie majani popote mtakapoyaona, kwa maana hakuna kitu kitakachopunguzwa katika kazi yenu.'"
sw.B: Nendeni ninyi wenyewe mkajitafutie majani popote mtakapoyapata. Lakini kazi yenu haitapunguzwa hata kidogo.'"
sw.R: Nendeni mkatafute majani popote mnapoweza. Lakini ni lazima mfanye matofali mengi kama zamani.'"

decisions.choice: you: emphatic
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stressed: "you yourselves" must now do it.

decisions.choice: you must still make just as many bricks
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "your labor will not be reduced" means here.

source.text: וַיָּ֥פֶץ הָעָ֖ם בְּכָל־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְקֹשֵׁ֥שׁ קַ֖שׁ לַתֶּֽבֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: And scattered the people in all [the] land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

en.L: So the people scattered throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
en.B: The people spread out over the whole land of Egypt to gather stubble to use as straw.
en.R: So the people went all over Egypt to find stubble, the leftover stalks in the fields, to use as straw.

es.L: Y se dispersó el pueblo por toda la tierra de Egipto para recoger rastrojo en lugar de paja.
es.B: El pueblo se esparció por todo Egipto para recoger rastrojo y usarlo como paja.
es.R: Así que la gente fue por todo Egipto a buscar rastrojo, es decir, los tallos que quedan en los campos después de la cosecha, para usarlo como paja.

fr.L: Et le peuple se dispersa dans tout le pays d’Égypte pour ramasser du chaume en guise de paille.
fr.B: Le peuple se répandit dans tout le pays d’Égypte pour ramasser du chaume qui servirait de paille.
fr.R: Alors les gens sont partis dans toute l’Égypte pour trouver du chaume, c’est-à-dire les tiges qui restent dans les champs après la moisson. Ils s’en servaient comme paille.

sw.L: Basi watu wakatawanyika katika nchi yote ya Misri ili kukusanya mabua badala ya majani.
sw.B: Watu walienea katika nchi yote ya Misri kukusanya mabua ya kutumia kama majani.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo watu walikwenda kila mahali Misri kutafuta mabua, yaani mashina yanayobaki shambani baada ya mavuno, ili wayatumie kama majani.

decisions.choice: stubble: the stalks left in a field after harvest
decisions.reason: Stubble was a poor substitute for chopped straw, and gathering it took time from brickmaking.

decisions.choice: the leftover stalks in the fields
decisions.reason: Readable explains "stubble".

source.text: וְהַנֹּגְשִׂ֖ים אָצִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֑ר כַּלּ֤וּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם֙ דְּבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּהְי֥וֹת הַתֶּֽבֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: And the taskmasters [were] pressing, saying, complete your works, [the] matter of [a] day in its day, as when there was the straw.

en.L: And the taskmasters kept pressing, saying, "Complete your works, each day's matter in its day, as when there was straw."
en.B: The taskmasters kept up the pressure: "Finish your work, each day's quota on its day, just as you did when straw was supplied."
en.R: The Egyptian bosses kept pushing them. They said, "Every day you must make as many bricks as you did when you were given straw."

es.L: Y los capataces los apremiaban, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Terminen|Terminad}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} obras, la tarea de cada día en su día, como cuando había paja».
es.B: Los capataces no dejaban de presionarlos: «{{plural_you:Terminen|Terminad}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} trabajo, la cuota de cada día en su día, igual que cuando se {{plural_you:les|os}} daba paja».
es.R: Los capataces egipcios seguían apurándolos. Les decían: «Cada día {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que hacer tantos ladrillos como cuando se {{plural_you:les|os}} daba paja».

fr.L: Et les chefs de corvée les pressaient, en disant : « Achevez vos ouvrages, la tâche de chaque jour en son jour, comme quand il y avait de la paille. »
fr.B: Les chefs de corvée ne relâchaient pas leur pression : « Terminez votre travail, la part de chaque jour le jour même, exactement comme lorsqu’on vous fournissait la paille. »
fr.R: Les chefs égyptiens les poussaient sans arrêt. Ils disaient : « Chaque jour, vous devez faire autant de briques que quand on vous donnait de la paille. »

sw.L: Nao wanyapara wakawahimiza, wakisema, "Timizeni kazi zenu, kazi ya kila siku katika siku yake, kama wakati majani yalipokuwapo."
sw.B: Wanyapara waliendelea kuwasukuma: "Malizeni kazi yenu, kiasi cha kila siku katika siku yake, kama mlivyofanya mlipokuwa mkipewa majani."
sw.R: Wanyapara wa Kimisri waliendelea kuwasukuma. Walisema, "Kila siku ni lazima mfanye matofali mengi kama mlipokuwa mkipewa majani."

decisions.choice: the matter of a day in its day: the daily amount
decisions.reason: The phrase means a fixed daily share. It is used of the daily portion of manna (16:4).

source.text: וַיֻּכּ֗וּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣מוּ עֲלֵהֶ֔ם נֹגְשֵׂ֥י פַרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּ֡וּעַ לֹא֩ כִלִּיתֶ֨ם חָקְכֶ֤ם לִלְבֹּן֙ כִּתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם גַּם־תְּמ֖וֹל גַּם־הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And were beaten [the] foremen of [the] sons of Israel whom [the] taskmasters of Pharaoh had set over them, saying, why have you not completed your quota to make bricks as yesterday [and the day] before, both yesterday and today?

en.L: And the foremen of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, whom Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, [and were] told, "Why have you not completed your quota of making bricks as before, both yesterday and today?"
en.B: The Israelite foremen whom Pharaoh's taskmasters had put in charge were beaten and asked, "Why have you not made your full quota of bricks, either yesterday or today, as you did before?"
en.R: Pharaoh's bosses had put some of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} in charge as crew leaders. Now the bosses beat these leaders and asked them, "Why did you not make as many bricks yesterday and today as you did before?"

es.L: Y fueron golpeados los encargados de los hijos de Israel, a quienes los capataces del faraón habían puesto sobre ellos, [y se les] dijo: «¿Por qué no {{plural_you:han completado|habéis completado}} {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cuota de hacer ladrillos como antes, ni ayer ni hoy?».
es.B: Los encargados israelitas, a quienes los capataces del faraón habían puesto al frente, fueron azotados y les preguntaron: «¿Por qué ni ayer ni hoy {{plural_you:han entregado|habéis entregado}} la cuota completa de ladrillos, como antes?».
es.R: Los capataces del faraón habían puesto a algunos israelitas como jefes de cuadrilla. Ahora los capataces golpearon a esos jefes y les preguntaron: «¿Por qué ayer y hoy no {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} tantos ladrillos como antes?».

fr.L: Et les contremaîtres des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, que les chefs de corvée de Pharaon avaient établis sur eux, furent battus, [et on leur] dit : « Pourquoi n’avez-vous pas achevé votre quota de briques comme auparavant, hier comme aujourd’hui ? »
fr.B: Les contremaîtres israélites, que les chefs de corvée de Pharaon avaient placés à la tête du peuple, furent frappés, et on leur demanda : « Pourquoi n’avez-vous pas fourni, hier ni aujourd’hui, votre nombre complet de briques comme auparavant ? »
fr.R: Les chefs de Pharaon avaient choisi quelques-uns des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} comme chefs d’équipe. Maintenant, ils ont battu ces chefs d’équipe et leur ont demandé : « Pourquoi n’avez-vous pas fait autant de briques qu’avant, hier et aujourd’hui ? »

sw.L: Nao wasimamizi wa wana wa Israeli, ambao wanyapara wa Farao walikuwa wamewaweka juu yao, wakapigwa, [wakiambiwa], "Mbona hamkutimiza kiasi chenu cha kufanya matofali kama zamani, jana na leo pia?"
sw.B: Wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli, ambao wanyapara wa Farao walikuwa wamewaweka kuwa wakuu wa kazi, walipigwa na kuulizwa, "Kwa nini jana na leo hamkukamilisha idadi yenu ya matofali kama zamani?"
sw.R: Wanyapara wa Farao walikuwa wamewachagua baadhi ya Waisraeli kuwa viongozi wa vikundi. Sasa wanyapara wakawapiga viongozi hao, wakawauliza, "Kwa nini jana na leo hamkufanya matofali mengi kama zamani?"

decisions.choice: the foremen were beaten: the Israelite officers were held responsible
decisions.reason: The foremen answered for their crews. They are beaten when the quota is not met.

decisions.choice: the sons of Israel: the people of Israel
decisions.reason: As from 1:7, the phrase means the people.

decisions.choice: children of Israel / Israelites; with the traditional setting, sons of Israel
decisions.reason: As in chapter 1. Balanced uses the adjective "Israelite", which needs no setting.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֧מָּה תַעֲשֶׂ֦ה כֹ֖ה לַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And came [the] foremen of [the] sons of Israel and cried out to Pharaoh, saying, why do you do thus to your servants?

en.L: And the foremen of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel came and cried out to Pharaoh, saying, "Why do you treat your servants this way?
en.B: Then the Israelite foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh: "Why do you treat your servants like this?
en.R: So the Israelite crew leaders went to Pharaoh and complained loudly. They said, "Why are you treating us, your servants, this way?

es.L: Y vinieron los encargados de los hijos de Israel y clamaron al faraón, diciendo: «¿Por qué tratas así a tus siervos?
es.B: Entonces los encargados israelitas fueron a quejarse ante el faraón: «¿Por qué tratas de esta manera a tus siervos?
es.R: Entonces los jefes de cuadrilla israelitas fueron a ver al faraón y se quejaron a gritos. Le dijeron: «¿Por qué nos tratas así a nosotros, que somos tus siervos?

fr.L: Et les contremaîtres des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël vinrent crier vers Pharaon, en disant : « Pourquoi agis-tu ainsi envers tes serviteurs ?
fr.B: Alors les contremaîtres israélites allèrent se plaindre à Pharaon : « Pourquoi traites-tu ainsi tes serviteurs ?
fr.R: Alors les chefs d’équipe israélites sont allés voir Pharaon et se sont plaints très fort. Ils lui ont dit : « Pourquoi nous traites-tu comme ça, nous qui sommes tes serviteurs ?

sw.L: Nao wasimamizi wa wana wa Israeli wakaja, wakamlilia Farao, wakisema, "Mbona unawatendea watumishi wako hivi?
sw.B: Ndipo wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli walipokwenda kumlalamikia Farao: "Kwa nini unawatendea watumishi wako namna hii?
sw.R: Basi viongozi wa vikundi wa Kiisraeli walikwenda kwa Farao, wakalalamika kwa sauti kubwa. Wakasema, "Kwa nini unatutendea hivi sisi watumishi wako?

decisions.choice: cried out to Pharaoh: not to God
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of Israel's cry to God (2:23; 3:7). Here the foremen take their cry to Pharaoh.

decisions.choice: your servants: a polite way of saying "we"
decisions.reason: Speaking to a superior, people called themselves his servants. It is also the word for slaves; the foremen speak as Pharaoh's slaves.

source.text: תֶּ֗בֶן אֵ֤ין נִתָּן֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ וּלְבֵנִ֛ים אֹמְרִ֥ים לָ֖נוּ עֲשׂ֑וּ וְהִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדֶ֛יךָ מֻכִּ֖ים וְחָטָ֥את עַמֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Straw is not given to your servants, and bricks they say to us, make; and look, your servants are beaten, and the fault [is with] your people.

en.L: Straw is not given to your servants, and they say to us, 'Make bricks!' And look, your servants are being beaten, but the fault [is with] your own people."
en.B: No straw is given to your servants, and still they say to us, 'Make bricks!' Now your servants are beaten, though it is your own people who are in the wrong."
en.R: You do not give us any straw, but your bosses still tell us to make bricks. Now they are beating us. But it is your own people's fault, not ours."

es.L: No se da paja a tus siervos, y nos dicen: “¡{{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} ladrillos!”. Y he aquí que tus siervos son golpeados, pero la culpa [es de] tu pueblo».
es.B: A tus siervos no se les da paja, y aun así nos dicen: “¡{{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} ladrillos!”. Ahora golpean a tus siervos, cuando los que están en falta son los de tu propio pueblo».
es.R: No nos das paja, pero tus capataces nos siguen diciendo que hagamos ladrillos. Ahora nos están golpeando. Pero la culpa es de tu propia gente, no nuestra».

fr.L: On ne donne pas de paille à tes serviteurs, et l’on nous dit : “Faites des briques !” Et voici, tes serviteurs sont battus, mais la faute [est à] ton peuple. »
fr.B: On ne fournit plus de paille à tes serviteurs, et pourtant on nous dit : “Faites des briques !” Maintenant on frappe tes serviteurs, alors que c’est ton propre peuple qui est en tort. »
fr.R: Tu ne nous donnes pas de paille, mais tes chefs nous disent toujours de faire des briques. Maintenant, ils nous battent. Pourtant, c’est la faute de ton propre peuple, pas la nôtre. »

sw.L: Watumishi wako hawapewi majani, nasi tunaambiwa, 'Fanyeni matofali!' Na tazama, watumishi wako wanapigwa, lakini kosa [ni la] watu wako."
sw.B: Watumishi wako hawapewi majani, hata hivyo tunaambiwa, 'Fanyeni matofali!' Sasa watumishi wako wanapigwa, ingawa wenye kosa ni watu wako mwenyewe."
sw.R: Hutupi majani, lakini wanyapara wako bado wanatuambia tufanye matofali. Sasa wanatupiga. Lakini kosa ni la watu wako mwenyewe, si letu."

decisions.choice: the fault is with your people: the Egyptians are to blame
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is short and unusual: "and sin, your people". It most likely means that Pharaoh's own people, the Egyptian taskmasters, are at fault. The Septuagint reads "you wrong your people", and some change the vowels to read "you sin against your people".

source.text: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר נִרְפִּ֥ים אַתֶּ֖ם נִרְפִּ֑ים עַל־כֵּן֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֔ים נֵלְכָ֖ה נִזְבְּחָ֥ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, idle [are] you, idle; therefore you [are] saying, let us go, let us sacrifice to Yahweh.

en.L: And he said, "You [are] idle, idle! That is why you say, 'Let us go and sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'
en.B: But he answered, "You are idle, nothing but idle! That is why you keep saying, 'Let us go and offer sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'
en.R: Pharaoh said, "You are lazy! You are just lazy! That is why you keep saying, 'Let us go and offer sacrifices to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'

es.L: Y él dijo: «¡Ociosos [son] {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, ociosos! Por eso {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Vayamos a ofrecer sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}”.
es.B: Pero él contestó: «¡{{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{plural_you:son|sois}} unos ociosos, nada más que unos ociosos! Por eso {{plural_you:andan|andáis}} diciendo: “Vayamos a ofrecer sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}”.
es.R: El faraón les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{plural_you:son|sois}} unos perezosos! ¡Nada más que perezosos! Por eso {{plural_you:repiten|repetís}} siempre: “Queremos ir a ofrecer sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}”.

fr.L: Et il dit : « Paresseux [vous êtes], paresseux ! C’est pourquoi vous dites : “Allons sacrifier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} !”
fr.B: Mais il répondit : « Vous êtes des paresseux, rien que des paresseux ! Voilà pourquoi vous répétez : “Allons offrir des sacrifices {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} !”
fr.R: Pharaon a dit : « Vous êtes des paresseux ! De vrais paresseux ! C’est pour ça que vous dites toujours : “Nous voulons aller offrir des sacrifices {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} !”

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Ninyi [ni] wavivu, wavivu! Ndiyo sababu mnasema, 'Twende tukamtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu.'
sw.B: Lakini yeye akajibu, "Ninyi ni wavivu, wavivu tu! Ndiyo maana mnaendelea kusema, 'Twende tukamtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu.'
sw.R: Farao akasema, "Ninyi ni wavivu! Wavivu kabisa! Ndiyo maana mnasema kila mara, 'Tunataka kwenda kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu.'

decisions.choice: idle, idle: repeated in contempt
decisions.reason: Pharaoh repeats the charge of verse 8, now to the faces of the Israelite foremen.

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ לְכ֣וּ עִבְד֔וּ וְתֶ֖בֶן לֹא־יִנָּתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם וְתֹ֥כֶן לְבֵנִ֖ים תִּתֵּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now go, work; and straw will not be given to you, and [the] full measure of bricks you shall give.

en.L: And now go, work; and straw shall not be given to you, yet you shall deliver the full quota of bricks."
en.B: Now go and work. You will be given no straw, but you must still turn in the full count of bricks."
en.R: Now go back to work! You will not get any straw. But you must still make all the bricks you are supposed to make."

es.L: Y ahora {{plural_you:vayan|id}}, {{plural_you:trabajen|trabajad}}; no se {{plural_you:les|os}} dará paja, pero {{plural_you:entregarán|entregaréis}} la cantidad completa de ladrillos».
es.B: Ahora {{plural_you:vayan|id}} a trabajar. No se {{plural_you:les|os}} dará paja, pero {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} que entregar el número completo de ladrillos».
es.R: ¡Ahora {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a trabajar! No se {{plural_you:les|os}} va a dar paja. Pero {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que hacer todos los ladrillos que {{plural_you:les|os}} toca».

fr.L: Et maintenant, allez, travaillez ; on ne vous donnera pas de paille, mais vous livrerez la quantité complète de briques. »
fr.B: Maintenant, allez travailler. On ne vous donnera pas de paille, mais vous devrez quand même remettre le compte entier des briques. »
fr.R: Maintenant, retournez au travail ! Vous n’aurez pas de paille. Mais vous devez quand même faire toutes les briques qu’on vous demande. »

sw.L: Basi sasa nendeni, fanyeni kazi; wala hamtapewa majani, lakini mtatoa hesabu kamili ya matofali."
sw.B: Sasa nendeni mkafanye kazi. Hamtapewa majani, lakini ni lazima mlete idadi kamili ya matofali."
sw.R: Sasa rudini kazini! Hamtapata majani. Lakini ni lazima mfanye matofali yote mnayotakiwa kufanya."

decisions.choice: the measure of bricks: the fixed number
decisions.reason: The word means a measured amount; here the full quota.

source.text: וַיִּרְא֞וּ שֹֽׁטְרֵ֧י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֹתָ֖ם בְּרָ֣ע לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־תִגְרְע֥וּ מִלִּבְנֵיכֶ֖ם דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw [the] foremen of [the] sons of Israel themselves in trouble, when [it was] said, you shall not reduce from your bricks, [the] matter of a day in its day.

en.L: And the foremen of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel saw that they [were] in trouble when [they were] told, "You shall not reduce [the number of] your bricks, each day's matter in its day."
en.B: The Israelite foremen knew they were in serious trouble when they were told, "You must not reduce your daily count of bricks."
en.R: The Israelite crew leaders saw that they were in big trouble. They had been told, "You must make the same number of bricks every day."

es.L: Y los encargados de los hijos de Israel se vieron en apuros cuando [se les] dijo: «No {{plural_you:reducirán|reduciréis}} [el número de] {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ladrillos, la tarea de cada día en su día».
es.B: Los encargados israelitas comprendieron que estaban en un grave aprieto cuando se les dijo: «No {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} reducir {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cuota diaria de ladrillos».
es.R: Los jefes de cuadrilla israelitas vieron que estaban en un gran problema. Les habían dicho: «Cada día {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que hacer la misma cantidad de ladrillos».

fr.L: Et les contremaîtres des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël se virent dans le malheur quand [on leur] dit : « Vous ne retrancherez rien [du nombre] de vos briques, la tâche de chaque jour en son jour. »
fr.B: Les contremaîtres israélites comprirent qu’ils étaient en mauvaise posture quand on leur déclara : « Vous ne diminuerez en rien votre compte quotidien de briques. »
fr.R: Les chefs d’équipe israélites ont vu qu’ils avaient de gros ennuis. On leur avait dit : « Chaque jour, vous devez faire le même nombre de briques. »

sw.L: Nao wasimamizi wa wana wa Israeli wakajiona [kuwa] katika taabu walipoambiwa, "Msipunguze [idadi ya] matofali yenu, kazi ya kila siku katika siku yake."
sw.B: Wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli walitambua kwamba wamo katika taabu kubwa walipoambiwa, "Msipunguze idadi yenu ya matofali ya kila siku."
sw.R: Viongozi wa vikundi wa Kiisraeli waliona kwamba wako katika shida kubwa. Walikuwa wameambiwa, "Ni lazima mfanye idadi ile ile ya matofali kila siku."

decisions.choice: saw themselves in trouble: realised their situation was bad
decisions.reason: "Trouble" is the word for evil or harm. Moses uses the verb from this root against God in verses 22-23: "why have you done harm?"

source.text: וַֽיִּפְגְּעוּ֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֔ן נִצָּבִ֖ים לִקְרָאתָ֑ם בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מֵאֵ֥ת פַּרְעֹֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they met Moses and Aaron standing to meet them as they came out from Pharaoh.

en.L: And they met Moses and Aaron, who were standing to meet them as they came out from Pharaoh.
en.B: As they came out from Pharaoh's presence, they found Moses and Aaron standing there waiting for them.
en.R: When they left Pharaoh, they found Moses and Aaron waiting for them outside.

es.L: Y encontraron a Moisés y a Aarón, que estaban de pie para salir a su encuentro cuando ellos salían de la presencia del faraón.
es.B: Al salir de la presencia del faraón, se encontraron con Moisés y Aarón, que estaban allí esperándolos.
es.R: Cuando salieron de donde estaba el faraón, encontraron a Moisés y a Aarón esperándolos afuera.

fr.L: Et ils rencontrèrent Moïse et Aaron, qui se tenaient là pour aller à leur rencontre quand ils sortirent de chez Pharaon.
fr.B: En sortant de chez Pharaon, ils trouvèrent Moïse et Aaron qui se tenaient là à les attendre.
fr.R: Quand ils sont sortis de chez Pharaon, ils ont trouvé Moïse et Aaron qui les attendaient dehors.

sw.L: Nao wakakutana na Musa na Haruni, waliokuwa wamesimama kuwalaki walipotoka kwa Farao.
sw.B: Walipotoka mbele ya Farao, waliwakuta Musa na Haruni wamesimama pale wakiwangoja.
sw.R: Walipotoka kwa Farao, waliwakuta Musa na Haruni wakiwasubiri nje.

decisions.choice: met: came upon, encountered
decisions.reason: The verb can also mean to confront someone. Moses and Aaron were waiting to hear the outcome.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם יֵ֧רֶא יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְיִשְׁפֹּ֑ט אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִבְאַשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־רֵיחֵ֗נוּ בְּעֵינֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ וּבְעֵינֵ֣י עֲבָדָ֔יו לָֽתֶת־חֶ֥רֶב בְּיָדָ֖ם לְהָרְגֵֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said to them, may Yahweh look upon you and judge, because you have made our smell stink in [the] eyes of Pharaoh and in [the] eyes of his servants, to put [a] sword in their hand to kill us.

en.L: And they said to them, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} look upon you and judge, because you have made our smell stink in the eyes of Pharaoh and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us."
en.B: They said to them, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} see what you have done and judge you! You have made us hateful to Pharaoh and his officials, and you have handed them a sword to kill us."
en.R: They said to Moses and Aaron, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} see what you have done and punish you! You have made Pharaoh and his officials hate us. You have given them a reason to kill us."

es.L: Y les dijeron: «Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} mire y juzgue, porque {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} que nuestro olor apeste a los ojos del faraón y a los ojos de sus siervos, poniéndoles una espada en la mano para matarnos».
es.B: Les dijeron: «¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vea lo que {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} juzgue! {{plural_you:Han hecho|Habéis hecho}} que el faraón y sus funcionarios nos aborrezcan, y les {{plural_you:han puesto|habéis puesto}} en la mano una espada para matarnos».
es.R: Les dijeron a Moisés y a Aarón: «¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vea lo que {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} castigue! Por culpa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, el faraón y sus funcionarios nos odian. Les {{plural_you:han dado|habéis dado}} un motivo para matarnos».

fr.L: Et ils leur dirent : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous regarde et juge, car vous avez rendu notre odeur puante aux yeux de Pharaon et aux yeux de ses serviteurs, en leur mettant une épée à la main pour nous tuer. »
fr.B: Ils leur dirent : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} voie ce que vous avez fait, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous juge ! Vous nous avez rendus odieux à Pharaon et à ses ministres, et vous leur avez mis en main une épée pour nous tuer. »
fr.R: Ils ont dit à Moïse et à Aaron : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} voie ce que vous avez fait et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous punisse ! À cause de vous, Pharaon et ses ministres nous détestent. Vous leur avez donné une raison de nous tuer. »

sw.L: Nao wakawaambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awaangalie na kuhukumu, kwa sababu mmeifanya harufu yetu kunuka machoni pa Farao na machoni pa watumishi wake, hata kuwatia upanga mkononi mwao ili watuue."
sw.B: Wakawaambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na aone mlichofanya, awahukumu! Mmetufanya tuchukiwe na Farao na maafisa wake, nanyi mmewapa upanga mkononi ili watuue."
sw.R: Wakawaambia Musa na Haruni, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na aone mlichofanya na awaadhibu! Mmemfanya Farao na maafisa wake watuchukie. Mmewapa sababu ya kutuua."

decisions.choice: made our smell stink: made us hated
decisions.reason: To make someone "stink" is to make them hateful to others (Genesis 34:30; 1 Samuel 13:4). The verb is used of the Nile stinking in the first plague (7:18).

decisions.choice: put a sword in their hand: given them an excuse to kill us
decisions.reason: A picture of providing a reason or the means for violence.

decisions.choice: his servants: Pharaoh's officials
decisions.reason: The king's "servants" are his court and officials.

source.text: וַיָּ֧שָׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֗י לָמָ֤ה הֲרֵעֹ֨תָה֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה שְׁלַחְתָּֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And returned Moses to Yahweh and said, my Lord, why have you done harm to this people? Why [is] this [that] you sent me?

en.L: And Moses returned to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, "Lord, why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} done harm to this people? Why did {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} ever send me?
en.B: Moses turned back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, "Lord, why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought this evil on this people? Why did {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} send me at all?
en.R: Then Moses went back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in prayer. He said, "Lord, why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} let this terrible thing happen to these people? Why did {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} send me here?

es.L: Y volvió Moisés {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y dijo: «Señor, ¿por qué has hecho daño a este pueblo? ¿Para qué me enviaste?
es.B: Moisés se volvió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y dijo: «Señor, ¿por qué has traído esta desgracia sobre este pueblo? ¿Para qué me enviaste?
es.R: Entonces Moisés fue a orar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Le dijo: «Señor, ¿por qué has dejado que le pase algo tan terrible a esta gente? ¿Por qué me mandaste aquí?

fr.L: Et Moïse retourna vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et dit : « Seigneur, pourquoi as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fait du mal à ce peuple ? Pourquoi donc m’as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} envoyé ?
fr.B: Moïse se tourna de nouveau vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et dit : « Seigneur, pourquoi as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} attiré le malheur sur ce peuple ? Pourquoi m’as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} seulement envoyé ?
fr.R: Alors Moïse est allé prier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a dit : « Seigneur, pourquoi as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} laissé arriver une chose si terrible à ces gens ? Pourquoi m’as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} envoyé ici ?

sw.L: Naye Musa akamrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "Bwana, mbona umewatendea mabaya watu hawa? Mbona hasa ulinituma?
sw.B: Musa akamgeukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "Bwana, kwa nini umewaletea watu hawa mabaya? Kwa nini basi ulinituma?
sw.R: Kisha Musa akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akasema, "Bwana, kwa nini umeacha jambo hili baya liwapate watu hawa? Kwa nini ulinituma huku?

decisions.choice: done harm: brought trouble
decisions.reason: The verb is from the root "evil". Moses blames God directly for the people's suffering, a bold complaint like many in the Psalms (Psalm 44:24-25).

decisions.choice: returned to Yahweh: turned to God in prayer
alternatives: went back to the place where God spoke to him
decisions.reason: The place is not given; the phrase describes Moses turning from the people to God.

decisions.choice: in prayer
decisions.reason: Readable says what "returned to the LORD" means here.

source.text: וּמֵאָ֞ז בָּ֤אתִי אֶל־פַּרְעֹה֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר בִּשְׁמֶ֔ךָ הֵרַ֖ע לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה וְהַצֵּ֥ל לֹא־הִצַּ֖לְתָּ אֶת־עַמֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has done harm to this people, and you have not delivered your people at all.

en.L: And since I came to Pharaoh to speak in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, he has done harm to this people, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not delivered {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people at all."
en.B: From the moment I went to speak to Pharaoh in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, he has treated this people cruelly, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done nothing at all to rescue {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people."
en.R: Since I went to Pharaoh and spoke for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, he has been even harder on these people. And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not saved {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people at all!"

es.L: Y desde que fui al faraón para hablar en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, él ha hecho daño a este pueblo, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} de ningún modo has librado a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo».
es.B: Desde el momento en que me presenté ante el faraón para hablarle en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, él ha maltratado a este pueblo, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no has hecho absolutamente nada para rescatar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo».
es.R: Desde que fui a hablar con el faraón de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} parte, él trata a esta gente todavía peor. ¡Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no has salvado a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo para nada!».

fr.L: Et depuis que je suis allé vers Pharaon pour parler en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, il a fait du mal à ce peuple, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as nullement délivré {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple. »
fr.B: Depuis que je suis allé parler à Pharaon en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, il maltraite ce peuple, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as absolument rien fait pour délivrer {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple. »
fr.R: Depuis que je suis allé parler à Pharaon de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} part, il est encore plus dur avec ces gens. Et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas du tout sauvé {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple ! »

sw.L: Kwa maana tangu nilipokwenda kwa Farao kusema kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, amewatendea mabaya watu hawa, wala {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hukuwaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hata kidogo."
sw.B: Tangu nilipokwenda kusema na Farao kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, amewatesa watu hawa, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} hujafanya lolote kabisa kuwaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}."
sw.R: Tangu nilipokwenda kwa Farao kusema kwa niaba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, amezidi kuwatesa watu hawa. Na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hujawaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hata kidogo!"

decisions.choice: you have not delivered at all: the verb is doubled for emphasis
decisions.reason: The doubled verb stresses the complaint: "you have not rescued them in the least". God answers in 6:1.

decisions.choice: speak in your name: speak as your messenger, with your authority
decisions.reason: To speak in someone's name is to speak for them.
